title: Ghost waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- Ghost body: pale glowing lavender-white -->
    <path d='M30 78 L30 45 C30 22 45 12 50 12 C55 12 70 22 70 45 L70 78 L64 72 L58 80 L50 73 L42 80 L36 72 Z'
          fill='#e8e0ff'/>
    <!-- Bottom shading to separate from screen -->
    <path d='M30 72 L30 78 L36 72 L42 80 L50 73 L58 80 L64 72 L70 78 L70 72 L64 68 L58 75 L50 68 L42 75 L36 68 Z'
          fill='#c9b8f2'/>
    <!-- Left arm, waving up -->
    <path d='M30 50 C20 48 14 36 16 28 C17 24 22 24 23 28 C24 35 28 42 32 44 Z'
          fill='#e8e0ff'/>
    <!-- Arm edge shade -->
    <path d='M30 50 C24 49 20 44 18 38 C20 46 25 49 31 47 Z' fill='#c9b8f2'/>
    <!-- Wave motion lines -->
    <path d='M10 24 C13 26 13 30 10 32' fill='none' stroke='#ffd84d' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M6 30 C9 32 9 36 6 38' fill='none' stroke='#ffd84d' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- Right side small arm -->
    <path d='M70 52 C76 52 80 56 80 62 C78 58 74 56 70 56 Z' fill='#d8ccf8'/>
    <!-- Eyes: dark violet ovals with light shine -->
    <ellipse cx='42' cy='40' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#5b3fa8'/>
    <ellipse cx='58' cy='40' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#5b3fa8'/>
    <circle cx='40.5' cy='37.5' r='1.7' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <circle cx='56.5' cy='37.5' r='1.7' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <!-- Cheeks: warm pink -->
    <ellipse cx='36' cy='52' rx='4' ry='2.6' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
    <ellipse cx='64' cy='52' rx='4' ry='2.6' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
    <!-- Smiling mouth -->
    <path d='M45 54 Q50 60 55 54' fill='none' stroke='#5b3fa8' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
</svg>
